title: Chapter 27 Enemies From Outer Space, A War In The Void
content:
Chapter 27 Enemies From Outer Space, A War In The Void

In the city lord's mansion.

Lu Daosheng looked up and his expression did not change at all.

Since I dare not hide it, I am not afraid of others robbing it.

The next moment, at the call of Lu Daosheng, senior executives such as Awei, An Xing, and Yun Qi appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"City Lord."

Several people saluted Lu Daosheng respectfully.

"Next, there will be many enemies in my deserted city. At that time, the safety and order in the city must be well controlled and there will be no chaos."

Suddenly, Awei said directly: "City Lord, just leave this matter to his subordinates."

Lu Daosheng nodded and then continued, "Yunqi."

"I'm here."

"Those enemies don't have to be merciful. As long as they dare to come, they can't let anyone go."

"Yes! Lord, my subordinates will make them come and go."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled with satisfaction.

At this time, An Xing spoke, "Sir, what about me?"

Lu Daosheng looked at An Xing and immediately pondered.

Now An Xing has reached the Dao Realm, and because he often abandons An Xing, An Xing's strength is not weak at all. As long as he is not a powerful person in the ancient realm, An Xing is almost invincible.

What's more, An Xing's body has a body of nothingness and has long been greatly improved.

In the void space, An Xing is invincible, elusive and extremely difficult to deal with.

"This way, you can investigate the identities of the other party's people clearly. If conditions permit, it's okay to capture a few important people alive."

Hearing this, An Xing nodded and said, "Yes, Lord City Lord."

And at this time, Gu Chen also came here.

"Sir, I'll go too."

Now ancient Chen is about to break through, and the next realm is the ancient realm.

"good."

"Dad, then I'm going to go too."

"no!"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Lu Daosheng suddenly became anxious.

That's a big battle. What if you accidentally hurt your daughter?

Suddenly, Lu Xue's little face collapsed.

On the side, Gu Chen also spoke, "Xiaoxue, it's better to listen to your father and stay here honestly."

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue had to compromise.

"All right."

In this way, a few people left directly.

And the next moment, a huge bell rang out from the deserted city.

Hearing the bell, everyone stopped what was going on.

They knew that this was a sound that would only be made when an enemy attacked.

Is the deserted city going to be attacked by the enemy? !

Suddenly, everyone felt like they were facing a great enemy.

Now they are tied to the deserted city, which can be said to be a shared honor and disgrace.

And some people are ecstatic.

For example, the Nangong family.

"That's great, the opportunity is here, hahahaha."

"Grandpa, what do you mean?"

Looking at Nangong Fang excitedly, Nangong Yu was a little confused.

Hearing this, Nangong Fang glared at Nangong Yu with some regret.

"Don't you want to enter the inner city?"

Inner City!

That is the dream of all those who enter the deserted city.

Suddenly, Nangong Yu remembered.

Only by making great contributions to the deserted city can you be eligible to enter the inner city.

"Grandpa, do you want to?"

"Yes, the Nangong family also needs to participate in the war, not only fight for the deserted city, but also fight for itself."

"If the entire Nangong family can be allowed to enter the inner city, even if I die in battle, what's the harm?"

When Nangong Yu heard his grandfather's words, his eyes suddenly turned red.

"grandfather,,"

Immediately, Nangong Ban left without looking back and went to find the people from the city lord's mansion.

At the same time, not only Nangong Fang, but many people with the same strength as Nangong Fang began to take action.

"Huh? Your Nangong family is going to participate in the war, too?"

Awei said in surprise.

"good."

Nangong Fang nodded, "I also want to give me a chance to the Nangong family."

Hearing this, Awei hesitated for a moment, then nodded.

"Okay, but I'll agree first. No one will take care of you when facing the enemy. If you die, you will die."

Nangong Fang did not hesitate.

Seeing this, Awei brought Nangong Fang to Yunqi.

At this time, Yunqi was rectifying the army.

Seeing the Lu family army with more than 300,000 people, Nangong Fang was stunned as if struck by lightning.

Is this the mysterious army in Huangcheng?

It's so scary.

There are more than 300,000 people, the lowest is the strength of the holy realm.

The lowest.

And Yun Qi could not stand it just after just taking a look.

Now, after a hundred years of cultivation, he has successfully broken through the enlightenment and reached the quasi-emperor realm. In a short time, he will be able to completely become an emperor.

I thought that he could be considered a master in the deserted city, but it turned out that he was short-sighted.

Looking at the uniform and high-spirited Lu family army, Nangong Fang looked respectful.

In this battle, we don’t seek to make contributions, as long as we don’t drag the army down.

Just then, a few loud roars came from outside the sky.

The next moment, a huge black warship enveloped the entire deserted city, covering the sky and the sun.

At the same time, another rumbling sound rang out.

A huge giant sword broke through the air and appeared not far from the black warship.

"Dark Galaxy?"

"Giant Sword Galaxy?"

Both were obviously a little surprised when they saw each other.

But at this time, the old man on the black warship exclaimed: "Young Master, look!"

Suddenly, in the void, everyone looked at the deserted city below.

Hiss ~

The sound of gasping in the air came out together.

"Hahahaha, I've got rich."

The young master of Xieyun Sect immediately called out excitedly.

The Sword Sect was also very excited that day.

I thought it was a treasure, but I didn't expect it was a bunch of treasures.

And they are also some legendary treasures.

Looking at one of the high towers below, the leader of the Giant Sword Sect said enthusiastically: "I, Tianjian Sect, will definitely win that tower."

Sword Tower.

There are countless sword wills in it, and all geniuses with the qualifications to cultivate swords will enter the sword tower to practice.

Of course, only the city lord's mansion and the inner city can enjoy the qualification to enter the sword tower.

Hearing the words of the Tianjian Sect, Xieyun Sect smiled disdainfully.

I want all the choices when children make.

"We will take it with our own abilities."

Immediately, the powerful people of the Xieyun Sect rushed out.

Seeing this, the faces of the Tianjian Sect changed and they rushed out.

The next moment, bang!

Everyone was turned away.

Because at some point, an invisible barrier appeared on the deserted city.

Seeing this, everyone in the deserted city breathed a sigh of relief.

"The city lord is awesome!"

Seeing the barrier, the Xieyun Sect and the Tianjian Sect looked a little ugly.

There are quite a few treasures in this group of inferior natives.

Obviously they thought it was a defensive treasure.

On the wall of Huangcheng City, Huang Shou lay on the ground and looked at the Xieyun Sect and the Giant Sword Sect above, with no hope of life in his eyes.

I really want to go up and kill them with one sword.

It’s a pity that Lu Daosheng told him not to take action.

Now that he can only watch here.

"The trash inside, get out for me. No, I hand over the treasures. Otherwise, hum,

The young master of the Xieyun Sect looked at the rest of the land outside the deserted city, his eyes full of madness.

Looking at the arrogant Xieyun Sect.

Suddenly someone couldn't help it.

I saw several people flew directly over the barrier of the deserted city and came outside the void.

"You guys, let's see how I deal with you today."

The person who came was the Zhang family and Li family in the inner city.

At this moment, they all have the realm of a great emperor.

"Yeah, there are really a few crawlers coming out."

The young master of Xieyun Sect said sarcastically.

Hearing this, Zhang Cheng looked angry, "If you want to attack Huangcheng, you can pass this level first."

Immediately, Zhang Cheng rushed over directly.

Seeing this, the rest followed.

"Everyone is fighting with the Zhang family's baby!"

Seeing these people rushing towards them, the eyes of the Xieyun Sect and the Tianjian Sect were full of disdain.

Lower galaxies are lower galaxies.

All are waste.

The next moment, a powerful man in the Heavenly Emperor Realm stood up.

Then he punched out.

boom!

The huge force directly shocked the Zhang family and others to retreat repeatedly.

But the young master of Xieyun Sect frowned slightly and said, "What's going on? Why are you still holding back?"

But the powerful man in the Heavenly Emperor realm was a little speechless.

He didn't hold back, he really put in all his strength.

These people should have been completely beaten into scum.

Just as he was about to continue to take action, a terrifying aura suddenly came.

"Friends, please step down first."

boom!

The next moment, a middle-aged man wearing dark golden armor appeared in the void.

It is the clouds that rise.

At the same time, more than 300,000 troops also appeared behind Yun Jia.
